[[File:Jim Haskell DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Jim Haskell at DecipherCon 1999.]]
'''Jim Haskell''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Gold 89 from Woodbridge, Va. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

Listed as James Haskell, he learned the game from his son in November 1996. He became a tournament director in April 1998 and joined Gold Squadron in September 1998 on [[Ryan Werntz]]'s suggestion.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

Before joining Gold Squadron he ran a [[Shawn Valdez (player)|Shawn Valdez]] tournament; he played his first sanctioned tournament in March 1998.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
I like TD more than playing. There's a lot less stress enforcing the rules than trying to play by them.

Thank you Decipher for making this product.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>
